steps.text: 2004: expressways 62.7 km/h, arterial roads 24.8 km/h. The shaded bands are LTA's targets.
2016: arterial roads at 30.4 km/h, above the band. It happened again in 2023. The sealed bet that every scored year would sit inside the bands failed on these years.
2025: expressways at 55 km/h, the lowest in the record and still inside the band.

howto: Each panel is one kind of road. The line is the average speed at peak hours in each year; the shaded band is the range LTA aims for.
A ringed dot marks a year outside the band. 2020 and 2021 are drawn faint: the piece did not score the pandemic years.
Drag the slider, or press Play, to move through the years.
source_line: Source: Land Transport Authority via data.gov.sg, through the piece's own pipeline.
